questions.question: What was the day of the week on 15th September 2005 ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/348f982b0f11da79622a28648c7ff0060dd4610e466d7b8200b60c592ba2a0d8.png] 

**The years which are multiple of 400 have 0 odd days.**

So, No. of odd days in 2000 = 0

No. of odd days in 2001 = 1 (Non leap year)

No. of odd days in 2002 = 1 (Non leap year)

No. of odd days in 2003 = 1 (Non leap year)

No. of odd days in 2004 = 2 (Leap year)

Total no. of days in from 1st January 2005 to 15th September 2005 = (31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 15) = 258 = 36 weeks and 6 odd days

Total no. of odd days = 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 6 = 11 = 1 week and 4 odd days

Therefore, No. of odd days = 4 which is the code for Thursday.

So, 15th September 2005 was Thursday.

Hence, **Thursday** is the correct answer.

questions.question: If N > H > Q = X and H = F = C < T, then which of the following options is NOT correct ?
questions.solution:
Given statements are N > H > Q = X and H = F = C H = F = C > Q = X

1) C H = F = C > Q = X ⇒ C > X)

2) Q H = F = C > Q = X)

3) H H = F = C > Q = X)

4) N > X (True, N > H = F = C > Q = X)

Hence, **C < X** is the correct answer.

questions.question: An amount of Rs. 6,764 is to be distributed among four friends P, Q, R and S in the ratio of 8 : 6 : 3 : 2 How much amount will P and R get in total ?
questions.solution:
Let 'x' be a common multiple.

Let the amount distributed between P, Q, R and S be 8x, 6x, 3x and 2x respectively.

So, 8x + 6x + 3x + 2x = 6764

19x = 6764

x = 356

Amount received by P = 8 × 356 = 2848

Amount received by R = 3 × 356 = 1068

Amount received by P and R in total = 2848 + 1068 = 3916

Hence, **Rs. 3,916** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct:

24 ÷ 12 × 21 - 273 + 14 = 179
questions.solution:
1) 14 and 21, × and +

Given equation is : 24 ÷ 12 × 21 - 273 + 14 = 179

After interchanging the numbers and signs in L.H.S, we get : 

24 ÷ 12 + 14 - 273 × 21

= 2 + 14 - 273 × 21

= 2 + 14 - 5733

= 16 - 5733

= -5717 (False)

**2) 14 and 21, + and ÷**

**Given equation is : 24 ÷ 12 × 21 - 273 + 14 = 179**

**After interchanging the numbers and signs in L.H.S, we get :**

**24 + 12 × 14 - 273 ÷ 21**</p&

questions.question: In a certain code language. 'OCTAGRAM' is written as 'ACOTAGMR'. How will 'GRACEFUL' be written in that code language ?
questions.solution:
Here, the first four alphabets of the given word are arranged alphabetically and then last four alphabets of the given word are arranged alphabetically.

Therefore, given word is "GRACEFUL"

First four alphabets are GRAC. If arranged alphabetically, it will be written as ACGR

Last four alphabets are EFUL. If arranged alphabetically, it will be written as EFLU

Combining both terms we get ACGREFLU.

Hence, **ACGREFLU** is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a class, 24 students have scored more marks than Vineet, whereas 19 students have scored lesser marks than Surbhi. questions.solution:
24 students have scored more marks than Vineet.

Vineet < 24 students

19 students have scored lesser marks than Surbhi

19 students < Surbhi

Arti has scored more marks than Surbhi, but lesser marks than Vineeet.

Surbhi < Arti < Vineet

Arti has scored lesser marks than 29 students and more marks than 26 students.

26 students < Arti < 29 students

Therefore, 26 + 1 + 29 = 56

Hence,** 56** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is ture, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All aero-planes are cars.

All helicopters are cars.

All cars are scooters.

**Conclusions:**

1. All helicopters are scooters.

2. Some aero-planes are helicopters.

3. No aero-plane is helicopter.

options.text: Conclusion 2 and either conclusion 1 or 3 follow.
Conclusion 1 and either conclusion 2 or 3 follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27d2e6cb2d63f33ee2e023ef18755b635a30e7fc47185b5fa668e4001a6b5888.png] 

Conclusions :

1. All helicopters are scooters. → True (as shown in the diagram)

2. Some aero-planes are helicopters. → False (it is possible but not definite)

3. No aero-plane is helicopter. → False (it is possible but not definite)

Thus, conclusions 2 and 3 form a complementary pair.

Hence, "**Conclusion 1 and either conclusion 2 or 3 follow**" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If A denotes 'addition', B denoted 'multiplication', C denotes 'subtraction', and D denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following equation:

63 D 7 B (9 A 4) A 24 C (264 D 88)
questions.solution:
Given expression is 63 D 7 B (9 A 4) A 24 C (264 D 88)

 
 

 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 Addition
 Multiplication
 Subtraction
 Division
 
 

 

Replacing A with 'addition', B with 'multiplication', C with 'subtraction', D with 'division' and applying BODMAS Rule,

63 ÷ 7 × (9 + 4) + 24 - (264 ÷ 88)

= 63 ÷ 7 × 13 + 24 - 3

= 9 × 13 + 24 - 3

= 117 + 24 - 3

= 141 - 3

= 138

Hence, **138 **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 11
 29
 22
 
 

 17
 23
 ?
 
 

 112
 208
 156
questions.solution:
Let the missing number be x.

The pattern followed here is :

Column 1: (11 + 17) × 4 = 28 × 4 = 112

Column 2: (29 + 23) × 4 = 52 × 4 = 208

Column 3: (22 + x) × 4 = 156

⇒ 88 + 4x = 156

⇒ 4x = 156 - 88

⇒ 4x = 68

⇒ x = 17

Hence, **17** is the correct answer.

Which of the following expressions means 'U is the mother of D' ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c0b6882f6a2b239a9d1a898a1e469d76972482b68e0de9cfe3363832ac34aec.png]

1) **D & S # K % U @ Z** → D is brother of S. S is sister of K. K is son of U. U is husband of Z

In this case U is a male. Therefore, this option is rejected.

2) **D % S # K & Z @ U** → D is son of S. S is sister of K. K is brother of Z. Z is husband of U

Possible family tree diagram will be :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d0338e8978b716153cd75ad19586de3f8816c012b7101748e5751ee144c6655.png]

3) **D & S # K % Z @ U** → D is brother of S. S is sister of K. K is son of Z. Z is husband of U

Possible family tree diagram will be :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d8c08c25cf761a351725d9526b7134883ab3e74104ef63c8c041f56732e10d2.png] 

Therefore, U is the mother of D.

4) **U & S # K % Z @ D** → U is brother of S. S is sister of K. K is son of Z. Z is husband of D

In this case U is a male. Therefore, this option is rejected.

Hence,** "D & S # K % Z @ U"** is the correct answer.
